title: KubeCon 2026 - Travel & Expense Scratchpad
content:
Quick scratchpad for KubeCon EU 2026 (Barcelona) - admin, expenses, vendor contacts, and things to remember. Mostly notes to self + items to sync with Liam/Sofia.

Key dates and travel basics:
- Conference dates: 2026-03-23 to 2026-03-26 (Wed- Fri).
- Travel window: depart 2026-03-22 (red-eye option) - return 2026-03-27.
- Badge pickup: expo hall, morning of 2026-03-23 (arrive early to avoid lines).
- Booth setup: 2026-03-22 17:00-20:00 (confirm pallet handling with venue).

Flights & arrivals (bookings / reminders):
- Flight (outbound): UA 812 - SFO -> BCN via FRA (check baggage allowance; aim for 1 checked + carry-on).
- Return: LH 493 (BCN -> FRA -> SFO) - late evening, verify connection time.
- Reminder: scan boarding passes and attach to expense report ASAP.

Hotel / lodging:
- Hotel: Hotel Barcelona Center (reservation under "Redwood Inference / Asha Patel").
- Check-in: 2026-03-22 after 15:00; check-out: 2026-03-27 before 12:00.
- Ask hotel for early bag drop and invoice addressed to Redwood Inference (billing email: finance@redwood.ai).

Ground transport / local logistics:
- Taxi/ride: estimate €40 each way from BCN airport to city center. Use receipts for reimbursement.
- Local SIM / eSIM: consider Airalo eSIM for 7 days (~€8) or use company phone roaming. Save receipt.
- Uber vs taxi: prefer licensed taxi for large luggage; still expense.

Booth & shipping (vendor contacts):
- Booth crate shipment: contact logistics vendor "FastExpo Logistics" - Pedro Morales, pedro@fastexpo.com, +34 612 555 010. Confirm delivery window (22 March 09:00-12:00).
- AV provider: "SoundStage BCN" - quotes sent 2026-02-05. Contact: Marta Ruiz, mruiz@soundstagebcn.com. Confirm HDMI adaptors + mic.
- Furnishings: table skirts and riser ordered via venue catalogue (order #VN-9921). Double-check arrival and pickup times.

Expense process (what to collect + how to code):
- Must-haves for reimbursement: original receipts (paper or PDF), card transaction, per diem notes, justification if >$200.
- Scan receipts with Expensify app or take high-res photo and upload to Concur (depending on team preference).
- Expense categories (Concur codes): travel.air, travel.hotel, travel.transport, events.catering, events-swag.
- Per-diem: follow company policy - meals included in per-diem when no client entertaining. Save receipts for any meals > $75.
- Currency: collect receipts in EUR and mark amounts; let finance handle FX conversion but note exchange rate on large cash payments.

Swag & promotional items:
- Extra stickers and one-pager datasheets packed in carry-on. Confirm 2x demo laptops + power strips.
- Giveaways shipped separately: 250 polos + 500 stickers. Track AWB and confirm customs clearance. If customs fees occur, get itemized invoice for reimbursement.

People & schedule (who's doing what):
- Asha: lead logistics, flights/hotel, badge pickup, final expense report.
- Liam: booth lead - setup, demo readiness, AV testing.
- Sofia: sessions and speaking slot coordination, panel prep, talk deck.
- Action: schedule 30-min sync 2026-03-12 to align on final packing and responsibilities.

Vendor payment notes / PO numbers:
- FastExpo Logistics PO: PO-7784 (confirm invoice should reference PO-7784).
- SoundStage BCN invoice to be routed to finance@redwood.ai with project code INF-2026-KC.

Unresolved / to confirm:
- Confirm ship-from address and timeline for swag crate (need customs paperwork by 2026-03-12).
- Verify whether booth carpet is included or we need to rent.
- Confirm whether exhibitor reception includes two guest passes (we may need 1 extra).
- Parking pass for van unloading on 2026-03-22 (apply via venue portal).

Expense estimate (rough):
- Flights: $1,300- $1,800 per person (round-trip).
- Hotel: ~€230/night * 5 nights = €1,150.
- Local transport & taxis: €120 total.
- Shipping & customs: estimate €400-€800 (depends on pallet/air freight).
- AV rental: €600.
- Swag production: $2,500 (ordered already).
- Contingency: 10% of total.

Reimbursement checklist (post-trip):
- Upload all boarding passes + hotel folio + original receipts to Concur within 30 days.
- Fill expense report: include trip purpose (KubeCon 2026 - Redwood booth), attendees (Asha, Liam, Sofia), and PO references.
- Tag receipts with GL codes (travel.air / events.swag etc.).

Notes to self / helpful links:
- Confluence page: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/TRAVEL/KubeCon+2026 (contains final schedule + vendor contracts).
- Slack channel: #events-kubecon-2026 (use for live coordination during trip).
- Expense policy: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/FIN/Travel+and+Expense+Policy

Quick action items (next 2 weeks):
- [ ] Confirm swag AWB and customs docs (due 2026-03-12).
- [ ] Finalize booth AV order and invoice to finance (due 2026-03-05).
- [ ] Book any remaining flights for team and upload to Concur (due 2026-02-20).
- [ ] Reserve parking/loading pass via venue.
- [ ] Create shared folder for receipts (Google Drive) labeled: KubeCon-2026-Receipts.

If anything else comes up I'll drop quick notes here (ticket numbers, vendor replies, phone confirmations).

-- Asha
